Name: Nature Crystals - Iridium Crops
Author: Dhamos
Description:
Do you ever wonder why there isn't a official way to get iridium crops? Well, that isn't a oficial way, but al least is a way to get them.

Add "Crystal Nature" a totem (BigCraftable) that aged crops (Fruit, Flower, Vegetable and Forage) and make them iridium quality, you can buy the recipe from the Dwarf Volcano, by 4000 coins.

But, besides JA limitations, there's two recipes: Crystal Nature and Crystal Nature Cluster, because you can't have 10x BigCraftables via Recipes, so... You make 10x Crystal Nature Cluster (5 Earth Crystal, 2 Topaz, 2 Emeralds, 2 Rubys, 2 Amethyst, 2 Jades - Emily was right!), and make one Crystal Nature from each Crystal Nature Cluster.

I know, that's a lose of life quality, but at least the recipe have 25% margin profit, to become 'less annoying'.

How many days the crops needs to become iridium quality:

[code][spoiler]Normal-Silver quality flowers, fruits and vegetables take 2 days to become iridium quality.
Gold quality takes only one day.
Forage takes need only one day too.[/spoiler]
[/code]

Work especially good with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3609]Quality Products[/url].
